spans.s: मूल् vi. 1U (pres. मूलति-ते) 1. To take root, to be firm, to stand fast; 2. to accumulate.
मूल् (II) vi. 10U (pres. मूलयति-ते) To rear, to cause, to grow.With उद्-, 1. to root out, to extirpate; 2. to destroy.With निस्-, to eradicate.
मूल (I) m. An epithet of Śiva.

मूल (II) n. 1. The root of any plant or tree, कुल्यांभोभिः पवनचपलैः शाखिनो धौतमूलाः Sak.v.; 2. the root of anything, commencement, beginning, प्राचीमूले तनुमिव कलामात्रशेषां हिमांशोः Megh.ii.26, ii.16, R.vii.10; 3. the bottom of anything, foot, आमूलाद्रत्नसानोर्मलयवलयितादा च कूलात्पयोधेः Bh.V.iv.37; 4. the end of anything by which it is joined to something else; 5. authority, source, origin, तत्र मूलं मृग्यम् S.K.; 6. the original text of any work (as distinguished from a commentary); 7. vicinity; 8. basis, foundation; 9. a hereditary servant; 10. capital, stock, square root (in math.); 12. a king’s own territory, स गुप्तमुलप्रत्यंतः शुद्धपार्ष्णिरयान्वितः R.iv.26; 13. a thicket; 14. a vendor who is not a true owner, M.viii.202; 15. the root of long pepper; 16. one of the twenty-seven asterisms containing eleven stars.(मूलं बंध् ‘to take root.’)
मूला f. 1. The name of a plant; 2. the asterism Mūlā.
मूल-आधार n. the navel.
मूल-आभ n. a radish.
मूल-आयतन n. the original residence.
मूल-आशिन् a. living upon roots.
मूल-आह्व n. a radish.
मूल-उच्छेद m. utter destruction, eradication.
मूल-कर्मन् n. magic.
मूल-कारण n. the original cause.
मूल-कारिका f. a furnace, an oven.
मूल-कृच्छ्र m.n. a penance consisting in living solely upon roots.
मूल-केशर m. a citron.
मूल-गुण m. the coefficient of a root.
मूल-ज (I) m. a plant growing from a root.
मूल-ज (II) n. green ginger.
मूल-देव m. an epithet of Kansa.
मूल-द्रव्य, -धन n. stock, capital.
मूल-द्रव्य, -धन n. stock, capital.
मूल-धातु m. lymph.
मूल-पुरुष m. the male representative of a family.
मूल-प्रकृति f. the Pradhāna of the Sāṅkhyas (q.v.), Sank.
मूल-फलद m. the bread-fruit tree.
मूल-भद्र m. an epithet of Kansa.
मूल-भृत्य m. an old servant.
मूल-वचन n. an original text.
मूल-वित्त n. capital, stock.
मूल-विभुज m. a chariot.
मूल-शाकट, -शाकिन n. a field planted with edible roots.
मूल-शाकट, -शाकिन n. a field planted with edible roots.
मूल-स्थान n. 1. the supreme spirit; 2. wind, air; 3. base, foundation.
मूल-स्रोतस् n. the principal current of a river.
मूलक (I) m.n. 1. A radish; 2. an esculent root.
मूलक (II) m. A kind of poison.
मूलक-पोतिका f. a radish.
मूलिक m. An ascetic, a devotee.
मूलिन् m. A tree.
मूलिन a. (f. ना) Growing from a root.
मूलिन a. (f. ना) Growing from a root.
मूली f. A house-lizard.
मूलेर m. 1. A king; 2. the Indian spikenard.
मूल्य n. 1. Price, worth, काचमूल्येन विक्रीतो हंत चिंतामणिर्मया Sant.S.i.12; 2. wages, salary; 3. gain; 4. capital, principal.
